sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.category = 'Cast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.season = 9 AND T1.series = 'Law and Order'

SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.votes NOT IN (SELECT MAX(T1.votes) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id) ORDER BY T1.votes DESC LIMIT 1
